title: The Samuelson Hypothesis in Futures Markets: An Analysis Using Intraday Data
about: How futures volatility relates to remaining maturity.
findings: Abstract supports the maturity-volatility effect especially in agricultural futures; not a signed net-return strategy.
mechanism: Time-to-maturity risk structure can inform sizing, without implying profitable direction.
